question: How do letter-streams bear consciousness in the consciousness-ground?
premises: So many objects are without distinction.
Consciousness is in true valid-cognition form.
inference: Those letter-streams, considered in the consciousness-ground without distinction among so many objects, bear consciousness as true valid cognition.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of tāvato'rthānabhedataḥ is unclear.
The precise referent of varṇaughāste is not fully specified.
plain_english: Considering in the ground of consciousness, those streams of letters bear consciousness as true valid cognition, without distinction among so many objects.
